name: Phong Nha
provinceNote: The park’s own pages give the address as Phong Nha Commune, Quang Tri Province.
summary: A village beside a national park famous for its caves, about 50 km from Dong Hoi in central Vietnam. Take the boat along the Son River into Phong Nha Cave, walk the boardwalk in Paradise Cave, or book an expedition to Son Doong, then eat Son River fish and grilled chicken. Suits adventurous travellers and families alike.
timeNeeded: Half a day for the boat cave
fee: Each cave has its own ticket. Phong Nha Cave entrance 150,000 VND. Boat 700,000 VND round trip, up to 12 people. Adding Tien Son on that boat: 750,000 VND. Paradise Cave, park adult one-kilometre walk: 270,000 VND, buggy included. Vietjet: 250,000 VND. Son Doong: park page and operator 3,000 USD a person; operator also 80,000,000 VND. Dark Cave exploration package 450,000 VND and includes the cave; cheaper packages leave the cave out. Mooc Spring sightseeing 80,000 VND and does not include the swim. 4,500-metre kayak in Phong Nha Cave: 1,700,000 VND. Botanical garden on Road 20: 80,000 VND. OZO Park basic day ticket: 200,000 VND for an adult over 1.4 metres; lunch extra. Hang En, Oxalis: 9,500,000 VND, or about 358 USD, for two days. Hang Va: Oxalis 9,400,000 VND for two days; park English page about 346 USD. Eight Ladies Cave: free. Sinh Ton Valley: 1,650,000 VND for one day or 4,700,000 VND for two. Taxi fare: Check on arrival.
getThere: Dong Hoi Airport (VDH), then the road. The park puts Phong Nha Cave about 50 km from Dong Hoi. Minutes, the taxi fare, and the rail time from Hue: Check on arrival. Paradise Cave is at Km 16 on the west Ho Chi Minh road. Minutes from the village: Check on arrival. One-kilometre gate hours: Check on arrival. Mooc Spring is about 20 minutes from Phong Nha Cave. The botanical garden is about 10 km from the Tourism Center; gate hours: Check on arrival. Sinh Ton Valley starts at Km 19 on the west Ho Chi Minh road. Eight Ladies Cave hours: Check on arrival. Son Doong: be in Dong Hoi by 15:00 for the briefing. Summer boat board ends at 16:30; winter boat board ends at 15:45. The park does not name which months use which clock. Drive minutes, and the night tour named on the boat page: Check on arrival.
bestMonths: Jade-green water in the dry season; reddish in the rainy season
seoTitle: Phong Nha travel guide — Son Doong, Paradise Cave, the boat cave
seoDescription: Boat into Phong Nha Cave for half a day, walk the boardwalk in Paradise Cave, or book Son Doong as its own expedition. Eat Son River fish in the village after.
intro: You start at the Tourism Center on the Son River. The boat runs downstream for about 30 minutes, the engine goes off, and the crew rows you about 1,200 metres into Phong Nha Cave. The visit is about two and a half hours. Sleep in the village if you want that morning without a transfer.

The ordinary visit is that boat cave. Paradise Cave is a separate trip, the dry walk at Km 16 on the west Ho Chi Minh road. Son Doong is a separate expedition, six days and five nights with Oxalis from January to August, not a stop you add after lunch. Stay if the caves are the trip. Head for Hue if you wanted the citadel instead. As of 21 Oct 2026 the 2027 and 2028 Son Doong departures are fully booked.

Dark Cave and Mooc Spring are separate tickets too. The exploration package is the one that enters Dark Cave. Mooc’s sightseeing row is the walk, not the swim, and the spring is about 20 minutes from Phong Nha Cave. You can also book the 4,500-metre kayak inside Phong Nha Cave, the botanical garden on Road 20, OZO Park, Hang En, Hang Va, Eight Ladies Cave at the Road 20 memorial, or Sinh Ton Valley from Km 19.
gettingAround: Dong Hoi Airport (VDH) is the air gateway. Phong Nha Cave is about 50 km from Dong Hoi city. At the cave, buy the ticket at the Tourism Center and walk to the pier on the left. Paradise Cave is at Km 16 on the west Ho Chi Minh road.

stayAreas.name: Phong Nha village
stayAreas.summary: Sleep here if the boat leaves in the morning. The Tourism Center is the start of the half-day. Dong Hoi is the airport, about 50 km from the cave.

eat: Son River grass carp is the fish of Phong Nha-Ke Bang. Grilled chicken comes with muối cheo and sticky rice. In the buffer the dishes are cơm pồi, Láp, and rượu đoác.

season.label: Check the board
season.note: The Son River runs jade-green in the dry season and reddish in the rainy season. The park does not name those months. Chay River–Dark Cave may close in heavy rain, flooding, or storms. The boat board ends at 16:30 in the summer hours and at 15:45 in the winter hours.

faqs.q: Does the Phong Nha Cave ticket include the boat?
faqs.a: No. The entrance is 150,000 VND. The boat is 700,000 VND for the round trip, for up to 12 people. Adding Tien Son on that same boat is 750,000 VND.

faqs.q: Can you visit Son Doong on your own?
faqs.a: No. Oxalis runs it as a six-day, five-night expedition from January to August. The published prices are 3,000 USD a person and 80,000,000 VND. Be in Dong Hoi by 15:00 for the briefing. As of 21 Oct 2026 the 2027 and 2028 departures are fully booked.

faqs.q: Is Paradise Cave the same visit as the boat?
faqs.a: No. It is a separate dry cave at Km 16 on the west Ho Chi Minh road. The one-kilometre adult prices are 270,000 VND with the buggy, and 250,000 VND.
